label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 036 ]

blocks.text: Many people believe that a camel stores water in its hump, but this is not true. The hump is actually made mostly of fat. When food is hard to find, the camel can use this fat for energy, and the hump becomes smaller and may lean to one side. Camels can go a long time without drinking because their bodies lose very little water. They sweat very little, and on a hot day their body temperature can rise several degrees before they start to sweat. When a thirsty camel finally finds water, it can drink about 100 liters in ten minutes.
